featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share my heartfelt appreciation for Sophia Ma’am at Mind Wellness Centre.

She played a transformative role in helping our daughter overcome OCD and anxiety. What truly stands out about her is her professionalism and the way she expertly applies therapeutic techniques. She doesn’t rely only on talk therapy, her approach is structured, techniques based, and highly effective.

Within just 6–8 months, we saw a remarkable improvement. Our daughter was able to gradually come out of her fears, and most importantly, she feels extremely comfortable with Sophia ma’am. She opens up to her सहजता से, which made a huge difference in her healing journey.

We are deeply grateful for her guidance and would highly recommend her to any parent seeking support for their child’s emotional well-being!

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Sagar
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I first contacted Sophia in October 2024, I was struggling with issues of narcissistic personality disorder (NPD). This condition severely impacted my marriage and overall relationships. I had tried other therapists who never understood the root cause, or provided the sustainable improvement I needed.

Sophia is clearly an expert in the field. She started with a professional, scientific diagnosis and prepared a personalized, structured and actionable treatment plan. Her use of the EMDR technique helped tremendously in processing underlying trauma and achieving real breakthroughs. Rather than just offering coping mechanisms, she guided me through understanding the root of my challenges, focusing on building practical and tangible skills.

The impact has been profound. Sophia has been instrumental in making me a better person. I owe a lot to her.

featured_reviews.name: Chandreyee Manna
featured_reviews.review_text: Sophia is wonderful in every way possible. After having struggled with mental health issues for years, and after trying out a whole bunch of different therapists without any success, my friend recommended Sophia to me. The first session I had with her, the feeling I had was that she understood what I was saying. Not only did she diagnose me with everything that made sense finally including Borderline Personality Disorder and depression. She provided me with all the tools and techniques that have helped make day-to-day life and relationships so much better. If you search for BPD online, it says it takes anything between 18-24 months of therapy, but with Sophia, in less than a year, I felt good enough to be equipped to manage things. I live in the US, and even with different time zones, she was so flexible and accommodating with my schedule. I love a structured approach to everything I do, and that was exactly what Sophia provided to me. I highly recommend her as she definitely helped me make my life so much better.
